changes.summary: Reuse verified candidate builds and unchanged PR runtime checks, scope physical acceptance and refresh release gates automatically.

Integrate on-TV themes, offline personal previews and user Columns with categorized settings and synchronized update indicators in both editions; partial #69, retro/font contribution and physical-TV acceptance remain pending
Fix No-root Helper control ownership while preserving pairing; reject unsupported Root Home interfaces before installation (partial #133; retained recovery remains unresolved).

Add reviewed-source cancellation of never-activated Root installs, including pre-registration finalize failures and historical runtime inventories; device-specific recovery and firmware routing compatibility remain unverified (partial #101, #133, #143).
Fix No-root Home settings transport in the service jail
Integrate theme showcase, Appearance controls and PC-to-TV transfer
Add the optional Show Add app tile switch and Settings app picker in both editions; preserve app editing and empty Home navigation.
Prepare Root candidate QA and preserve Showcase focus
Retry installer TLS failures with the two RSA/AES-GCM suites on the encrypted endpoint; legacy-TV pairing and compatibility acceptance remain pending (#152).
Recover No-root Helper watchdog timeouts with bounded retries, persistent emergency stops and required input cleanup; exact-device acceptance remains pending (#155).
Replace unpublished theme ID provider with da.gd
Add reviewed CSS-only Itachi Sharingan theme to showcase, generic native icon quality preference and optional bounded white-logo styling; physical-TV acceptance remains untested.
Correct candidate documentation and record unattended host/artifact verification while preserving supervised Root, exact Helper rollback and Android upgrade gates.

Address the eight supervised RC findings in source: correct Itachi 1.0.1 preview, bound held-navigation lag, restore saved-theme first/warm presentation, stabilize Appearance, preserve explicit/legacy columns, and narrowly admit verified native TV foreground on boot/wake; add guarded System Updater 1.1.1 to 1.1.2 replacement, exact Helper approval and parallel preliminary device builds. Root 0.6.1; the targeted decision records six passes and two declared failed limitations (Appearance #170 and standby #171), which are planned follow-ups, not delivered fixes (#162).

Authenticate and durably archive completed prior System replacement history before new guarded 1.1.1 to 1.1.2 admission; the scoped maintainer C3 supervisor migration passed using the same frozen payload (#165).

Update shared TV theme rendering with a styleable scenic position indicator, single focused caption and icon-error recovery; publish the reviewed toolkit Itachi 1.0.2 catalog entry and improve reference-app/HDMI/showcase browser previews. This changes both TV editions, not only preview tooling.

Preserve app-origin theme and Columns preferences across normal System profile restore while retaining legacy reset and invalid-trial recovery; correct stale Columns focus handling. Actual-TV UI06 still shows a 110 px Appearance shift, explicitly accepted as a declared limitation with planned follow-up #170; no fix is claimed for that remaining failure (#168, #162).
